tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check whether the ATA MCP server responds. Returns 'pong'; does not search properties or change quotes or bookings.

tools.name: get_network_discovery_context
tools.description: Return a summary of ATA's current destinations, property types, capacity, amenities, views, and published suitability information. Use to identify supported discovery options when the traveler has not specified a property or destination. Does not check availability for specific dates.

tools.name: search_flexible_network_availability
tools.description: Search participating ATA properties for availability and prices across a flexible date window. Defaults to a window 28–56 days from today, three nights, and two adults only when those values are missing; always return those defaults as explicit assumptions. tools.name: get_company_mission
tools.description: Read ATA's published company mission and company description. Use for questions about ATA's purpose or services.

tools.name: get_traveler_memories
tools.description: Returns active structured memories for a verified traveler. Use this when you need durable personalization beyond the context already provided.

tools.name: suggest_traveler_memory
tools.description: Save or update one durable traveler memory for personalization. Use only for stable, travel-relevant preferences or constraints explicitly stated by the traveler.

tools.name: search_property_availability
tools.description: Search specific dates and occupancy for a known property using its propertyToken.

tools.name: search_network_availability
tools.description: Find accommodations across the ATA Travel Network with real-time pricing. Use when dates are known. Supports filtering by amenities, views, property type, and free-text keyword to handle vague requests.

tools.name: search_buildings
tools.description: Find published ATA building/complex profiles by destination, neighborhood, tag, amenity, or free-text. Use this for questions about buildings, condo towers, complexes, gated communities, marina developments, or neighborhoods.

tools.name: get_building_details
tools.description: Get a published ATA building/complex profile with assigned stays and map coordinates. Use slug from search_buildings or property search results.

tools.name: get_stays_in_building
tools.description: Return ATA stays assigned to a published building, optionally filtered by live dates and guest counts.

tools.name: search_property_catalog
tools.description: Browse participating ATA properties without stay dates. Filter by location, property type, amenities, views, or keyword. Does not check date-specific availability or prices.

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Get date-free property and room details, including traveler-facing amenities, property-authored direct-booking benefits, policies, Events & Weddings, room profiles, published image links and up to two bounded image previews (property and uniquely matched room). tools.name: get_support_contacts
tools.description: Get published ATA support and optional property guest contact details. Use for human help, unanswered property questions, or booking support. Returns configured contact links only; does not send messages, create a case, or transfer the traveler to a person. Omit propertyToken for ATA support alone.

tools.name: list_property_extras
tools.description: List date-free published events, services, activities, day passes, experiences, dining, wellness, packages, transfers, and other extras for a known property. Returns read-only offer details and ATA purchase links when the property is published on ATA; it does not create an order.

tools.name: start_traveler_verification
tools.description: Start general traveler verification for this MCP session after the traveler confirms their email address. Uses the property’s configured verification method. This does not create a quote, enquiry, hold, or booking.

tools.name: verify_traveler_code
tools.description: Consume the six-digit code for a challenge started in this MCP session. On success, ATA privately binds the verified traveler to this MCP session; no reusable bearer credential is returned.

tools.name: get_traveler_verification_status
tools.description: Check whether a code or email-link challenge started in this MCP session has completed. A completed link binds the traveler privately to this MCP session.

tools.name: start_traveler_handoff
tools.description: Internal approval step for quote or booking tools. Before calling, read guestEmail back to the traveler and confirm it is correct; then set emailConfirmedByTraveler=true. tools.name: get_traveler_handoff_status
tools.description: Check the verification status and permitted next actions for an existing ATA traveler handoff. Use the handoffId returned by start_traveler_handoff. Does not send email or create a quote or booking.

tools.name: get_quote_details
tools.description: Read a previously created quote using its actual quoteId, quoteHash or quoteUrl. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_traveler_code" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "start_traveler_handoff" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_support_contacts, get_traveler_verification_status, start_traveler_handoff, get_traveler_handoff_status, get_booking_details · Private data: get_support_contacts, verify_traveler_code, create_provisional_booking, create_quote · Public sink: get_support_contacts, start_traveler_verification, get_traveler_verification_status, start_traveler_handoff, get_traveler_handoff_status, get_booking_details, create_provisional_booking, create_quote · Destructive: get_booking_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_support_contacts, get_traveler_verification_status, start_traveler_handoff, get_traveler_handoff_status, get_booking_details · Private data: get_support_contacts, verify_traveler_code, create_provisional_booking, create_quote · Public sink: get_support_contacts, start_traveler_verification, get_traveler_verification_status, start_traveler_handoff, get_traveler_handoff_status, get_booking_details, create_provisional_booking, create_quote · Destructive: get_booking_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
